steps.code:
# Parse the old songs list from the file content
old_songs_text = old_songs_file["content"]
old_songs = []
for line in old_songs_text.splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line or line.startswith('#'):
        continue
    if line.startswith('- '):
        line = line[2:]
    # Split on " by " to get title and artist part
    if ' by ' in line:
        title_part, artist_part = line.split(' by ', 1)
        title = title_part.strip()
        artists = [a.strip() for a in artist_part.split(',')]
        old_songs.append((title, set(artists)))
    else:
        # maybe just title? but format seems consistent
        old_songs.append((line.strip(), set()))
print(f"Parsed {len(old_songs)} old songs")
for t, a in old_songs:
    print(t, a)
